plugin.name: Productivity
plugin.description: Notion, Airtable, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot and RSS: actions, live pickers, polling triggers and a GitHub webhook trigger.
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: notion
nodes.description: Create and query Notion database pages, get, archive and search pages, append blocks
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Work with Notion. Pick `resource` (databasePage, page, block) and `operation`: create a database page (`databaseId`, `title`), query a database (`databaseId`, optional `filterJson`), get or archive a page (`pageId`), search pages (`text`), or append paragraphs to a page (`blockId`, `text`).

properties.name: databaseId
properties.description: Databases shared with the integration (or an id / URL through an expression)

properties.name: title
properties.description: Value of the database's title property

values.name: key
values.description: Property name as shown in Notion

values.name: value
values.description: Multi-select: comma-separated; checkbox: true/false; date: ISO 8601

properties.name: propertiesJson
properties.description: Raw Notion property values, merged over the fields above, e.g. {"Tags": {"multi_select": [{"name": "a"}]}}

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a given limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return

properties.name: filterJson
properties.description: A Notion filter object, e.g. {"property": "Status", "status": {"equals": "Done"}}

properties.name: sortsJson
properties.description: An array of Notion sort objects, e.g. [{"property": "Due", "direction": "ascending"}]

properties.name: pageId
properties.description: Page id or URL

properties.name: text
properties.description: Text to search for in page titles (empty: everything shared with the integration)

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a given limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return

properties.name: simplify
properties.description: Whether to return a simplified version of the response instead of the raw data

properties.name: blockId
properties.description: Page or block id or URL; the new blocks are appended to its children

options.name: Paragraph Text
options.description: One paragraph per blank-line separated block of text

options.name: Blocks (JSON)
options.description: An array of Notion block objects

properties.name: blocksJson
properties.description: e.g. [{"type": "to_do", "to_do": {"rich_text": [{"text": {"content": "Ship it"}}]}}]

nodes.name: airtable
nodes.description: Create, upsert, get, search, update and delete Airtable records
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Read and write Airtable records in a table (`base` and `table` ids). Operations: `search` with an Airtable formula in `filterByFormula`, `get` / `deleteRecord` by record `id`, `create` / `update` / `upsert` with the record fields as a JSON object in `fieldsJson` (set `dataMode` to `json`).

properties.name: base
properties.description: Base id (app…)

properties.name: table
properties.description: Table id (tbl…) or name

properties.name: fieldsToMergeOn
properties.description: Comma-separated fields that identify a record: a match is updated, otherwise a record is created

options.name: Map Automatically
options.description: Use the input item's fields as the record's fields

options.name: Define Below
options.description: Set field names and values one by one

options.name: JSON
options.description: A JSON object of field names to values

properties.name: fieldsJson
properties.description: e.g. {"Name": "Ada", "Score": 42}

properties.name: filterByFormula
properties.description: An Airtable formula; only records for which it is true are returned

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a given limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return

values.name: view
values.description: View name or id; its filters and order apply

values.name: fields
values.description: Comma-separated fields to return (all when empty)

values.name: typecast
values.description: Let Airtable convert string values to the field types (and create missing select options)

values.name: ignoreFields
values.description: Comma-separated input fields not to send (Map Automatically)

nodes.name: github
nodes.description: Create, edit, comment on and list issues; get repositories, releases and files
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Work with a GitHub repository (`owner`, `repository`). Issues: `create` (`title`, `body`), `get` / `edit` / `createComment` by `issueNumber`, `getAll` (filters by state and labels). Also get the repository, list releases, or read a file's text (`filePath`).

options.name: Create Comment
options.action: Create a comment on an issue

properties.name: repo
properties.description: Pick one of your repositories, or enter the owner and name below

properties.name: body
properties.description: Markdown

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Comma-separated label names

properties.name: assignees
properties.description: Comma-separated user logins

values.name: labels
values.description: Comma-separated; replaces the current labels

values.name: assignees
values.description: Comma-separated logins; replaces the current assignees

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a given limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return

values.name: labels
values.description: Comma-separated; issues must have all of them

values.name: since
values.description: Only issues updated at or after this time

values.name: assignee
values.description: A login, 'none' or '*'

values.name: reference
values.description: Branch, tag or commit (default branch when empty)

nodes.name: githubTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow when a repository gets a new issue, pull request or release (polling)
nodes.subtitle: {{event}}

properties.name: pollInterval
properties.description: How often to check for new events while the workflow is active

properties.name: repo
properties.description: Pick one of your repositories, or enter the owner and name below

options.name: New Issue
options.description: An issue was opened (pull requests excluded)

options.name: New Release
options.description: A release was published (or drafted, with push access)

properties.name: pollNotice
properties.displayName: The first poll after activation only records the newest item; later polls emit what is newer, oldest first.

nodes.name: githubWebhookTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow on repository events as GitHub sends them: pushes, pull requests, issues, releases, …
nodes.subtitle: {{events}}

properties.name: webhookNotice
properties.displayName: Landflow creates the repository webhook when you publish the workflow and deletes it when you unpublish. The token needs admin:repo_hook (classic) or Webhooks read and write (fine-grained), and admin access to the repository.

properties.name: repo
properties.description: Pick one of your repositories, or enter the owner and name below

properties.name: events

options.name: Any Event
options.description: Every event GitHub sends for the repository

options.name: Create
options.description: A branch or tag was created

options.name: Delete
options.description: A branch or tag was deleted

options.name: Issue Comment
options.description: A comment on an issue or pull request

options.name: Issues
options.description: An issue was opened, edited, closed, labeled, …

options.name: Pull Request
options.description: A pull request was opened, synchronized, closed, …

options.name: Push
options.description: Commits were pushed to a branch or tag

properties.description: The events GitHub delivers; each starts one run

values.name: insecureSsl
values.description: Let GitHub deliver to a URL whose TLS certificate it cannot verify (self-signed); not recommended

nodes.name: jira
nodes.description: Create, get, search, update and transition Jira issues, and add comments
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Work with Jira issues. `getAll` searches with a JQL query in `jql`; `get` / `update` / `transition` take an `issueKey` like PROJ-123; `create` needs `project` and `issueType` ids and a `summary`; comments are added with resource `issueComment`, operation `add` and the `comment` text.

options.name: Transition
options.action: Move an issue to another status

values.name: description
values.description: Plain text; blank lines start new paragraphs (converted to ADF on Cloud)

values.name: labels
values.description: Comma-separated

values.name: assignee
values.description: Account id (Cloud) or user name (Server)

values.name: fieldsJson
values.description: Merged into `fields`, e.g. {"customfield_10011": "Epic name"}

values.name: description
values.description: Plain text; blank lines start new paragraphs (converted to ADF on Cloud)

values.name: labels
values.description: Comma-separated

values.name: assignee
values.description: Account id (Cloud) or user name (Server)

values.name: fieldsJson
values.description: Merged into `fields`, e.g. {"customfield_10011": "Epic name"}

properties.name: transitionId
properties.description: Transitions available for the issue (enter the issue key first)

properties.name: jql
properties.placeholder: project = PROJ AND status != Done ORDER BY created DESC
properties.description: Jira Query Language (Cloud requires a bounded query, e.g. with a project)

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a given limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return

values.name: fields
values.description: Comma-separated fields to return (default: all navigable fields)

properties.name: simplify
properties.description: Whether to return a simplified version of the response instead of the raw data

nodes.name: hubspot
nodes.description: Create or update, get and search HubSpot contacts; create deals
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Work with HubSpot CRM. Contacts: `upsert` by `email` (with optional names, phone, company), `get` by `contactId`, `search` with property filters. Deals: `create` with `dealName`, `stage`, `amount` and optional `associatedContactIds`.

properties.name: email
properties.description: The contact is looked up by email: updated when found, created otherwise

values.name: property
values.description: Internal property name

properties.name: filtersUi
properties.description: All filters must match (AND)

properties.name: query
properties.description: Free text matched against the default searchable properties (name, email, phone, company)

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a given limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return

values.name: properties
values.description: Comma-separated properties to return (HubSpot's defaults when empty)

values.name: sortBy
values.description: Search only

properties.name: simplify
properties.description: Whether to return the id and the properties as flat fields

values.name: associatedContactIds
values.description: Comma-separated contact ids to associate with the deal

values.name: property
values.description: Internal property name

properties.name: simplify
properties.description: Whether to return the id and the properties as flat fields

nodes.name: rssFeedRead
nodes.description: Read the items of an RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 (RDF) or Atom feed
nodes.subtitle: {{url}}
nodes.toolDescription: Read an RSS or Atom feed. Pass the feed address in `url`. Returns one item per entry with `title`, `link`, `isoDate`, `creator`, `contentSnippet` (plain text) and `categories`. Use it to get the latest news or posts.

properties.name: url
properties.description: URL of the RSS or Atom feed

values.name: customFields
values.description: Comma-separated extra elements to read from each item (prefix:name for namespaced ones)

nodes.name: rssFeedReadTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow when an RSS or Atom feed publishes a new item (polling)
nodes.subtitle: {{feedUrl}}

properties.name: pollInterval
properties.description: How often to check for new events while the workflow is active

properties.name: feedUrl
properties.description: URL of the RSS or Atom feed

properties.name: pollNotice
properties.displayName: The first poll after activation only records what is in the feed. Executing the node in the editor returns the latest item.
